data.name: Love Bombing (The Healthy Kind)
data.headline: Love bombing, but it’s two free classes and zero manipulation.
data.benefit: Love bombing, but healthy: write a friend a love letter at the desk and they get 2 classes on us. If they join, they get 15% off and grip socks, and you get 5 extra days. Three letters, three chances.
data.rationale: Referrals convert 41.2% at Kwality, 22.6% at Bandra, 28.3% at Kenkere and 76.1% at pop-ups, versus 3.8–5.7% for website leads. The 2026 BOGO codes (70 uses, ₹3.1L given) went mostly to existing clients; this one pays out only when a genuinely new person buys.
data.audience: Current members bringing a never-been friend.
data.conditions: The friend must be new to P57 (phone verified). Member reward: +5 days per buying friend, max 15. Standard 15% for the friend only.
data.kpi: Letters redeemed; new buyers from referral (target +40% vs Feb-26).

scenes.title: Blind Date (No Catfishing)
scenes.narration: New clients: Blind Date (No Catfishing). Blind date, but the only red flag is our grip socks. 9 buyers at 11,697 rupees — 1.05 lakh rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: Blind Date (No Catfishing)
data.headline: Two classes. You don’t know which. That’s the fun part.
data.benefit: Blind date, but the only red flag is our grip socks. Two mystery classes for ₹999 (Kenkere ₹709): you find out the format and the trainer at the door. Like what you see? We credit the full ₹999 against your first month.
data.rationale: Kenkere’s VDAY50! code (38 uses, ₹2.6L given away at 50%) bought February volume at a huge cost. A booked second visit lifts trial→member from 10.8% to 43.9%, and a mystery format gets newcomers into the class they would never pick, which is usually the one that sells the membership.
data.conditions: One per phone number. The intro fee is credited only within 72 hours of class 2. Standard 15% only; no stacking.
data.kpi: Second-date booked at the desk (target 70%); trial → member (target 30%).

scenes.title: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule
scenes.narration: Win-backs: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule. It’s not you, it’s your schedule. Come back on your terms. 4 buyers at 12,406 rupees — 49,624 rupees. 15 per cent off.

data.name: It’s Not You, It’s Your Schedule
data.headline: It’s not you, it’s your schedule. Pick a relationship status.
data.benefit: It’s not you, it’s your schedule. Come back on your terms: Exclusive (3 months), Casual (12 classes) or It’s Complicated (1 month + a free freeze). 15% off whichever you pick.
data.rationale: Lapsers average 2.6–3.4 visits in the first half of a membership vs 6.4 for renewers: they left because the plan did not fit the week, not because of the price. Letting them pick the commitment removes the objection without deepening the discount.
data.conditions: Lapsed 61–365 days. Standard lapsed 15% only; freezes have no cash value.
data.kpi: Reactivations; mix of Exclusive / Casual / Complicated (target 30% Exclusive).

scenes.title: Put a Ring On It
scenes.narration: Renewals: Put a Ring On It. If you like it, put a ring on it. 8 buyers at 43,000 rupees — 3.44 lakh rupees. 20 per cent off.

data.name: Put a Ring On It
data.headline: If you like it, then you should’ve put a 6-month on it.
data.benefit: If you like it, put a ring on it: renew for 3 months at 15% and get the ring (a mini-band, relax), 6 months at 15% with a private, or go annual and get your name on the Wall of Commitment.
data.rationale: Members using 75%+ of their sessions renew at 82–88%, and longer plans keep them using them. The best perks sit on the longest plans; nothing is unlocked by a class count, so every renewer qualifies.
data.audience: Members renewing in February (any expiry date).
data.conditions: 3M 16.4% / 6M 19.6% effective (perks at list); annual at the standard 20%. One ring per renewal. No stacking.
data.kpi: 3M+ share of renewal value (target 45%); proposals accepted at the desk.
